mapper.select: SELECT id,user_id,request_id,node_id,merchant_member_id,audio_sha256,audio_format,claim_token,state, CASE WHEN body_erased=0 AND body_expires_at>NOW(6) THEN transcript ELSE NULL END AS transcript, (body_erased=1 OR (body_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND body_expires_at<=NOW(6))) AS body_erased, handoff_started,text_admitted,body_expires_at,quota_reservation,quota_refund_pending FROM npc_asr_intent WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND request_id=#{requestId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE npc_asr_intent SET state=#{state},transcript=#{transcript}, body_expires_at=CASE WHEN #{state}='RECEIVED' THEN DATE_ADD(NOW(6),INTERVAL 48 HOUR) ELSE NULL END, update_time=NOW(6) WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND request_id=#{requestId} AND claim_token=#{claimToken} AND state='IN_FLIGHT' AND body_erased=0

UPDATE npc_asr_intent SET state='NOT_SENT',transcript=NULL,body_expires_at=NULL, quota_refund_pending=1,update_time=NOW(6) WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND request_id=#{requestId} AND claim_token=#{claimToken} AND quota_reservation=#{quotaReservation} AND handoff_started=0 AND text_admitted=0 AND state IN ('IN_FLIGHT','UNKNOWN')
mapper.select: SELECT id,user_id,request_id,node_id,merchant_member_id,claim_token,state, quota_reservation,quota_refund_pending,handoff_started,text_admitted FROM npc_asr_intent WHERE quota_refund_pending=1 AND state='NOT_SENT' AND quota_reservation IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE npc_asr_intent SET handoff_started=1,update_time=NOW(6) WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND request_id=#{requestId} AND state='RECEIVED' AND handoff_started=0 AND body_erased=0 AND body_expires_at>NOW(6) AND transcript IS NOT NULL AND transcript<>'' AND quota_reservation IS NOT NULL

UPDATE npc_asr_intent SET text_admitted=1,update_time=NOW(6) WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND request_id=#{requestId} AND node_id=-#{sessionId} AND state='RECEIVED' AND handoff_started=1 AND text_admitted=0 AND body_erased=0 AND body_expires_at>NOW(6) AND quota_reservation IS NOT NULL
UPDATE npc_asr_intent SET transcript=NULL,body_erased=1, state=CASE WHEN state='IN_FLIGHT' THEN 'UNKNOWN' ELSE state END,update_time=NOW(6) WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND body_erased=0
UPDATE npc_asr_intent SET transcript=NULL,body_erased=1,update_time=NOW(6) WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND body_erased=0 AND body_expires_at<=NOW(6)
UPDATE npc_asr_intent SET transcript=NULL,body_erased=1,update_time=NOW(6) WHERE body_erased=0 AND body_expires_at<=NOW(6) ORDER BY body_expires_at,id LIMIT #{limit}
